content:
maria: quick copy check — adding a small guidance pill next to the model dropdown to explain automatic fallback behavior. want a11y + tone feedback. proposed short copy below.

maria: Option A: "Auto-fallback: switches to a compatible model to keep requests online. Click for details."

maria: Option B (shorter): "Auto-fallback may change latency or output. Details."

jake: Option A is clear but a bit long for a pill. B reads terse — maybe soften: "Auto-fallback: may affect latency or quality. Learn more." :thinking_face:

aisha: Agree with Jake on length. Also: ensure the pill is keyboard focusable + screen-reader friendly. Suggest we add an aria-label that expands the hint, e.g. `aria-label="Auto-fallback behavior: when your chosen model is unavailable, the system routes to a compatible variant. This can change latency or output. Open docs for details."`

maria: nice. i'm concerned about the word "unavailable" — could alarm users. maybe "not reachable" or "temporarily unavailable"?

ben: Tone: emphasize continuity. Users care about reliability. Something like: "Seamless fallback keeps requests running; may affect latency or output. Learn more." That says reassurance first. :+1:

jake: +1 to reassuring lead. but keep pill copy <= 60 chars ideally. The full sentence can live in tooltip or aria label.

aisha: accessibility nit: tooltip must be reachable via keyboard and announced when focused. Implementation suggestion: use `role="button" aria-expanded="false"` and swap to `true` when the tooltip is visible. Also ensure the link inside has `aria-describedby` to tie back to the pill.

maria: noted. i'll hand off final aria attrs. for copy, proposing compressed pill text and full tooltip:

maria: Pill: "Auto-fallback — may affect latency/output"

maria: Tooltip (full): "If your selected model is temporarily unavailable, we route to a compatible model to keep your requests running. This may change latency or output quality. See docs for behavior and fallback order."

ben: LGTM. just a small wording tweak: change "See docs" -> "Learn more" (friendlier).

jake: also add a microcopy link target: `/docs/fallbacks#behavior` so people can deep link.

aisha: for screen readers, consider announcing "Auto-fallback info, link opens documentation" when pressing enter. maybe set `aria-label` on the link accordingly.

maria: great. one more product question — should we show this pill only when a user pins a non-default model or always? Thoughts?

jake: maybe show it when model != default && fallback is enabled. reduces noise.

ben: agree. fewer surprises. also track clicks as `ui.fallback_pill_click`.

maria: ok i'll update the mocks and add final copy with aria attrs. will push small PR and add acceptance criteria: keyboard nav, SR announcement, link target, analytics event.

deploy-bot: Reminder — small UI copy changes deployed to staging require visual test.

maria: thanks all — i'll land the PR tomorrow and tag design for a quick pass. :thumbsup:
